description.text:
A two-player Theme Deck kit built around Blaziken and Gardevoir, released on 18 October 2004 in English and European languages only. It holds two 60-card decks and four 10-card sideboard kits, two for each deck, to turn them into decks for 2-on-2 battles or for more competitive play, with a two-player mat, a 16-page strategy guide, damage and status counters and a coin.

Every card is a reprint from the first six EX Series expansions. Those from EX Ruby & Sapphire, EX Sandstorm and EX Dragon take the card design that began with EX Team Magma vs Team Aqua, without the e-Reader strip or e logo. On 13 July 2005 the two decks and their sideboard kits came out again on their own as the EX Master Trainer Decks, the Blaziken Deck and the Gardevoir Deck.

description.text: A non-holo Blaziken, found only in EX Battle Stadium: each of its two decks holds a non-holo copy of its flagship Pokémon beside the holo one. Like the kit's other EX Ruby & Sapphire reprints, it has no e-Reader strip.
